//: Worker defaults. No secret belongs in this file (coding-standards CF-3) — the connection string is supplied by the environment or a mounted secret.

Persistence.//: The Worker's OWN connection settings, independent of the API's (NFR-PERF-001, DP-001). Supply via Persistence__ConnectionString.

AuditPartitions.//IntervalMinutes: Daily. ADR-0014 lists retention enforcement as a scheduled daily job, and the creation horizon is measured in months.
AuditPartitions.//FutureMonths: How far ahead partitions must exist. This is the margin between the job silently breaking and audit events being lost.
AuditPartitions.//RetentionMonths: Documented floor is 12 (AU-7). The exact default above that is decision D-5, open with Product and Legal.
AuditPartitions.//DropExpiredPartitions: OFF by default. Legal holds are specified but not built (register item I-11), so nothing can confirm a partition is safe to destroy. Eligible partitions are reported every cycle instead.
